# Contributing to NPrep Backend

Thank you for your interest in contributing! Please read our full [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) in the root directory for detailed instructions.

## Quick Links

- [Commit Convention](./COMMIT_CONVENTION.md)
- [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [Security Policy](./SECURITY.md)
- [Pull Request Template](./PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

## Quick Start

```bash
# Clone and setup
git clone https://github.com/betaversionio/ui-website.git
cd ui-website
pnpm install

# Create branch
git checkout -b feature/your-feature

# Make changes and commit
git add .
git commit -m "🔥 feat: Your feature description"

# Push and create PR
git push origin feature/your-feature
```

## Commit Message Format

```
<emoji> <type>: <description>
```

| Emoji | Type       | Description    |
| ----- | ---------- | -------------- |
| 🔥    | `feat`     | New features   |
| 🐛    | `bug`      | Bug fixes      |
| ⚡    | `perf`     | Performance    |
| 🧹    | `chore`    | Maintenance    |
| 📚    | `docs`     | Documentation  |
| ♻️    | `refactor` | Refactoring    |
| 🚨    | `hotfix`   | Critical fixes |
| ✅    | `test`     | Tests          |

See [COMMIT_CONVENTION.md](./COMMIT_CONVENTION.md) for full details.

## Need Help?

- Check existing issues before creating a new one
- Use the appropriate issue template
- Be clear and provide context

Thank you for contributing!
